properties.site-address: Newcombe House - and 205 to 237 Kensington Church Street
properties.notes: Demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment to provide office, residential, and retail uses, and a flexible surgery/office use, across six buildings (ranging from ground plus two storeys to ground plus 17 storeys), with two storey basement together with landscaping to provide a new public square, ancillary parking and associated works. PP/17/05782 - On 26 March 2018 the Mayor of London notified RBKC that he will determine the application. https://www.rbkc.gov.uk/planning/searches/default.aspx
